subject: Build visible Westside homepage now
body: Build the real editable Westside homepage now in the connected Penpot file. Create or focus a 1440px desktop board named 02 — Westside Watch Homepage v0.1 with Living Paper #FAF9F5. Add a visible masthead and navigation, a large editorial hero with Ink #252525 and restrained First Light Gold #A2872A, a real feature section with a dominant 5:8 editorial frame, one-pixel rules, generous whitespace, and a brick or battlement architectural transition. Also create a meaningful mobile companion around 390px. Do not make palette strips, probe boards, tiny swatches, or planning artifacts. Use Cormorant Garamond and Noto Serif TC intent. Export the actual homepage board as PNG, run Gemma visual verification, correct visible hierarchy, spacing, and color failures, then re-export. Complete only after a real Penpot mutation, PNG image evidence, and visual verifier PASS. If mutation is blocked, return the exact tool or error evidence.
design_brief: Westside Watch contemporary editorial homepage. Preserve First Light #A2872A, Watch Night #102A43, Living Paper #FAF9F5, Ink #252525. Visual DNA: Light, Line, Paper, Engraving, Architecture. Grammar: Brick, Battlement, Flow. Quiet, intelligent, spacious, architectural, publishable.
